product_title: Handcrafted Shubh Labh Radha Krishna Pearl Toran
product_description: Enhance your home entrance with this beautifully handcrafted traditional toran, featuring auspicious Shubh Labh motifs, an enchanting Radha Krishna centerpiece, decorative golden elephants, vibrant pink lotus designs, and intricate golden embellishments. Finished with delicate pearl tassels and rich golden detailing, this elegant door hanging brings a divine, festive charm to your home. Perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, mandir entrances, and living spaces during Diwali, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other auspicious occasions. Its traditional design beautifully combines Indian artistry with timeless elegance.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth or a soft-bristled brush to remove dirt.
Avoid water, excessive moisture, and harsh cleaning chemicals to protect the fabric and decorative details.
Handle the pearl tassels, mirrors, and embellishments carefully to prevent tangling or damage.
Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the vibrant colors and golden finish.
Store in a dry place in a protective box or fabric bag when not in use.
